title: Oxford Dunes Carriage House in Rosemary Beach | Rosemary Beach – Rosemary Beach®
meta_description: Bright & Airy Oxford Dunes Carriage House is right at 600 square feet but gives the feeling of twice that. Come see what this carriage house and book your reservation today!
description_expanded:
Property includes dedicated Rosemary Beach® community Beach Access via 9 Private Beach Walkovers. Beach chair service available for an additional cost through RBPOA Beach Service. Complimentary access to Rosemary Beach® Fitness and complimentary court time at Rosemary Beach® Racquet Club also included.

Bright & Airy

Oxford Dunes Carriage House is right at 600 square feet but gives the feeling of twice that.

Separate bedroom and a spiral staircase that leads to a reading room/office. The windows create a light that is brilliant; it brings the color hues out in a warm and fresh environment. Seahorse cutouts, wavy iron railings, bold beams all solidify this amazing structure, all seated above the garage space.

Disclaimers:

**This property requires a 4 night minimum stay during spring break and summer and a 2 night minimum stay during shoulder season.

**No Wifi Provided**

**New construction next door.
